name: Carnivorous Creature (CR +1)
body:
Sometimes a herbivorous animal is forced to eat meat to survive when it can’t find other food. Rarely, it can acquire a taste for its new diet, and teach its young to live on meat too.

The most ferocious and evil of these creatures begin to crave the flesh of living beings as their only food and fly in a frenzy if they can’t have it.

Creating a Carnivorous Creature

“Carnivorous creature” is an acquired or inherited template that can be added to any animal (referred to hereafter as the base creature) that is normally herbivorous. A carnivorous creature uses the base creature’s statistics and special abilities except as noted here.

Challenge Rating: Same as base creature +1.
Size: The base creature’s size increases by one category if it is Medium or smaller.
Type: The creature’s type changes to magical beast. Do not recalculate its base attack bonus, saves, or skill ranks.
Alignment: Any evil.
Senses: A carnivorous creature gains darkvision 60 ft. It also gains scent if the base creature didn’t already possess it.
Attacks: A carnivorous creature gains a bite attack if it didn’t have one, dealing damage based on the creature’s size. Its bite is always a primary natural weapon.
